feature_api.input: One device, chronological numeric rows. No labels, device IDs or future rows. Select literal column names from profile.feature_names.
feature_api.output: pd.DataFrame of declared unique fe_ columns; preserve rows and index. Original columns are retained automatically.

past_helpers.past.gap_seconds(frame): Series: current minus previous observation time in seconds; first value NaN.
past_helpers.past.observation_count(frame): Series: causal count 1,2,...,n; no measured-value missingness dependence.

rules: Only assignments to new local names and a final return. No loops, comprehensions, imports or arbitrary functions.
frame.index is permitted ONLY as index=frame.index in pd.DataFrame. For time gaps use past.gap_seconds(frame).
No frame.columns, to_series, dt, iloc, loc, values, pd.Series, pd.to_numeric or apply. Inputs are already numeric.
Use arithmetic operators / + - * instead of .div/.add/.sub/.mul. Use literal column names; never discover columns dynamically.
Reductions must directly follow rolling/expanding/ewm. Use trailing real-time rolling windows; center=True and negative shifts are forbidden.
Missing measurements stay unknown unless the hypothesis explicitly justifies a constant or forward fill. No infinities.
Zero finite values in a bounded sample is a coverage limitation, not evidence that the entire dataset is empty.

hypotheses.mechanism: Correctable error (CE) rate accelerates before uncorrectable/device fault due to weakening cells.
hypotheses.basis: DRAM field studies show CEs often rise prior to hard failures; repeated corrected errors indicate marginal cells.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing devices do not show elevated 1h or 15m CE counts relative to healthy devices in TRAIN evidence.

hypotheses.mechanism: CEs constrained to a single DQ bit indicate a persistent weak bit/column rather than random noise.
hypotheses.basis: DQ-specific failures point to a bad bitline or sense amplifier; single-DQ dominance is a known fault signature.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing devices have similar or lower single-DQ counts than healthy devices; no DQ concentration appears.

hypotheses.mechanism: Burst errors with larger burst counts reflect spatial multi-bit damage along a row or column.
hypotheses.basis: DRAM row/column faults can produce multi-bit bursts; larger burst count indicates wider damaged region.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Burst-count distributions for failing devices do not shift toward larger burst sizes.

hypotheses.mechanism: Row/column faults are more predictive of device replacement than random cell faults.
hypotheses.basis: Row and column faults affect many addresses and can disable large memory regions; field maintenance often flags repetitive row/column errors.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing devices do not exhibit elevated row/column fault counts compared with healthy devices.

hypotheses.mechanism: Bank-level faults indicate a more severe structural defect than cell-level faults.
hypotheses.basis: Bank-level errors suggest shared circuitry failure and can affect larger memory regions.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Bank fault counts do not distinguish failing from healthy devices.

hypotheses.mechanism: Shorter inter-burst or inter-DQ intervals signal accelerating instability rather than isolated random errors.
hypotheses.basis: Decreasing time between errors suggests a progressive physical defect; isolated errors are more likely environmental.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing devices have longer or similar maximum intervals than healthy devices, showing no temporal clustering.

hypotheses.mechanism: CE storms (sudden bursts of many CEs) precede hard failures.
hypotheses.basis: Storm events indicate a rapid degradation phase and are commonly observed before memory faults.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Failing devices do not have more frequent CE storm or error-burst events.

hypotheses.mechanism: Log-transformed CE counts capture saturation or wide dynamic range better than raw counts.
hypotheses.basis: Log transformation can reveal multiplicative increases in error activity when raw counts are sparse but meaningful.
hypotheses.falsified_if: Log-transformed CE features do not show stronger separation than raw counts in TRAIN diagnostics.

acceptance_rule.explanation: best changes only when paired CV bootstrap 95% lower bound > lower_bound and net hits are not lost
